title: REQ · Inventory is a 3x2 grid of slots with item icons and names, empty slots included
summary: Six framed slots show generated item icons and names from game state.
description: Context: inventory renders a ul of ids or the text Empty. Desired behavior: a grid of exactly six sf-frame-slot cells, 3 columns by 2 rows; each filled slot shows the 16x16 icon from manifest id item/<id> and a readable name; remaining slots are empty placeholders. Expected result: layout is stable at any inventory size up to six.
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory ['old-key'], then 6 slots render, slot 1 has an img from item/old-key and the name 'Old Key', 5 slots are marked empty.
Given empty inventory, then 6 empty slots render and no img exists.
Given an item with no manifest icon, then its name shows without an img.

out_of_scope: more than six items scrolling rules
preserve: item icon PNGs and manifest entries

technical_constraints: Icons come from existing generated item/* manifest entries.
definition_of_done: Icons and names from game state
